verdict: Close to break-even: at 1.65R the target must come first in 38% of the replays that hit a side; it did in 35% (target first 33.2% vs stop first 62.1%).
plain: We replayed the trading window 5,000 times using this market's own recent price moves. The first target was reached before the safety exit in 33% of replays, the safety exit was hit first in 62%, and in 5% neither happened in time. In real history (59 past starts), the same distances hit the target first 11 times and the stop first 31 times. Overall: about a coin flip once the reward size is counted.
caveat: A simulation from recent bars, not a prediction. News, earnings and gaps can do what the last 60 days never did.
